industry.why: Overweight, carried unchanged. Component 1 regime, 23-Oct-26 (risk-off confirmed and broadening: the discount-rate squeeze now a positioning wash-out in the artificial intelligence complex with credit leading it, bonds rallied as a hedge for the first time this cycle while the Fed still hikes in December, the US 10-year near 5.10%, Brent $111, French sovereign stress spilling into Italy, European defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows and breadth in the bottom fifth of three years; sources present 2026-W43): Brent $111 (Jefferies, 22 Oct), oil above $100 and rising, and energy led the week; energy is the hedge inside a European book against the shock that hurts everything else. Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-23 against 2026-08-21, not week on week: A now, A prior at industry level. Not Double Overweight at the industry because the industry holds Metals and mining (relative strength F now from A) and Agriculture beside the three energy sectors; Downstream distribution carries the A. Counter-case: Goldman attributes part of the oil move to restocking, two months into leadership is where reversals begin, and 13 of the 18 upstream Pool names read F on TSR/Valuation, so the market has paid.

sector.why: Neutral, carried, with the disagreement now stated both ways. Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-23 against 2026-08-21, not week on week: F now, A prior, the largest fall in the table; against it, DNB Carnegie (22 Oct) reads mining demand as 'strong' in a new mining cycle and Danske has soft commodities up 10 to 40%, while gold and copper prices were not read. Component 1 regime, 23-Oct-26 (risk-off confirmed and broadening: the discount-rate squeeze now a positioning wash-out in the artificial intelligence complex with credit leading it, bonds rallied as a hedge for the first time this cycle while the Fed still hikes in December, the US 10-year near 5.10%, Brent $111, French sovereign stress spilling into Italy, European defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows and breadth in the bottom fifth of three years; sources present 2026-W43): industrial metals into a growth scare with dollar strength is the cyclical call the tape is making; the three Pool names (Glencore, Anglo American, Atalaya) all read D on Technical Momentum. Held Neutral: one house's demand read against a tape that has gone from A to F in two months. Moves to B if relative strength leaves F with a copper price read; to D on a third reading at F.

geography.why: Neutral, carried, with the evidence for a view named and judged thin. Goldman (19 Oct) names the UK index among those rallying with non-AI, low-beta exposures; its UK Weekly Kickstart 'The Value of Earnings' and the podcast 'The cavalry isn't coming: UK stocks' were titles only; the Bank of England and gilt yields were not read. One clause of index leadership on a 191-stock row, the largest in the table, is not a country view. Component 1 regime, 23-Oct-26 (risk-off confirmed and broadening: the discount-rate squeeze now a positioning wash-out in the artificial intelligence complex with credit leading it, bonds rallied as a hedge for the first time this cycle while the Fed still hikes in December, the US 10-year near 5.10%, Brent $111, French sovereign stress spilling into Italy, European defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows and breadth in the bottom fifth of three years; sources present 2026-W43). Relative strength is not graded by country. Moves to B if a second source makes the UK case with a rate path read.
